title: The infuence of powder morphology on the microstructure and mechanical properties of as‑sprayed and heat‑treated cold‑sprayed CP Ti

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: Al <0.02 wt%, Cr <0.02 wt%, Fe <0.02 wt%, Nb <0.02 wt%, Ni <0.02 wt%, V <0.02 wt%, C <0.2 wt%, O 0.11 wt%, N <0.01 wt%, balance Ti
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: dried overnight in a vacuum oven at 2.2 kPa and 90 °C
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: grit-blasted with 24-mesh alumina grits and cleaned using compressed air and acetone

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: mechanical and diffusion pump to reach the high vacuum of 5 × 10-3Pa.
